name: expectedValue_isLinearUtility
lines: ⊢ IsLinearUtility fun L => Lottery.expectedValue L f
⊢ (fun L => Lottery.expectedValue L f) (Lottery.mix α hα₀ hα₁ L₁ L₂) =
α * (fun L => Lottery.expectedValue L f) L₁ + (1 - α) * (fun L => Lottery.expectedValue L f) L₂
